name: Pool pump
description: A pump that circulates water through a swimming pool's filtration system.

fields.label: Horsepower
fields.description: Rated motor horsepower as stated by the manufacturer.

fields.label: Total horsepower
fields.description: Total horsepower including service factor, where the manufacturer states it.

fields.label: Speed type
fields.description: Whether the motor runs at one speed, two speeds, or a continuously variable speed.

fields.label: Voltage
fields.description: Supply voltage the pump is designed for.

fields.label: Maximum amperage
fields.description: Highest current draw stated by the manufacturer.

fields.label: Maximum flow rate
fields.description: Highest flow rate stated by the manufacturer, in US gallons per minute.

fields.label: Application
fields.description: The kind of pool the pump is intended for.

fields.label: Self priming
fields.description: Whether the pump can lift water and start on its own without being manually filled.

fields.label: Port size
fields.description: Diameter of the inlet and outlet connections. Text, because unions and mixed sizes occur.

fields.label: Housing material
fields.description: Material of the pump housing, as stated by the manufacturer.

fields.label: Strainer basket included
fields.description: Whether a hair and lint strainer basket is included.

fields.label: ENERGY STAR certified
fields.description: Whether the pump carries ENERGY STAR certification.

fields.label: Weighted energy factor
fields.description: The US Department of Energy efficiency rating (WEF), where published.

fields.label: Certifications
fields.description: Safety and performance listings, for example UL, CSA, NSF/ANSI 50, as a comma-separated list.

fields.label: Weight
fields.description: Shipping or unit weight in pounds, as stated by the manufacturer.

fields.label: Dimensions
fields.description: Length by width by height in inches, as stated by the manufacturer.

fields.label: Warranty
fields.description: The manufacturer's warranty terms, in the manufacturer's own words.
